name: helpdesk-api
description: The single API service of the help desk: it owns tickets, comments and members, computes SLA due times from priority, evaluates SLA breach when tickets are read, enforces the status transitions, accepts an assignee typed by username and binds it to that person's id on their first call, and serves the filtered queue. It is the one deployable for all domain logic because the requirements describe one API service; it does not send notifications, store files or run background jobs. Persistence needs a database resource, which is not available in the platform catalog yet (see Needs your input).

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Sign-in: the gateway validates tokens issued for this client.
